name: Still Pointz: Sauna & Breath
subtitle: Practice picked from your HRV
promotionalText: Right now reads your heart rate, HRV and sleep from your Watch or WHOOP in Health and picks one practice for this moment. Plus sauna and steam sessions.
description:
Still Pointz doesn't ask you to scroll a library. Open it and Right now shows one practice for this moment, picked from what your Apple Watch or WHOOP saves to Apple Health: heart rate, HRV, breathing rate, last night's sleep and today's workouts. Tap Start, close your eyes, and let your iPhone or Watch keep the rhythm.

RIGHT NOW
One practice, chosen for this moment. Heart rate above your resting rate or HRV under your usual gets a calming breath; just out of the sauna or a workout, a cool-down; after a short night, something gentle; late evening, a wind-down. Why this? shows every number behind the pick and where it came from, on iPhone and on your Watch, with a simple stress estimate made from your own numbers. The Right now widget keeps the pick on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

SAUNA AND STEAM SESSIONS
Tap Sauna or Steam as you walk in. A session timer, heat-safe breathing and gentle bench moves, then your heart rate for the session. Your heat days feed back into the next Right now pick.

GENTLE 6 AM AND BEDTIME PICKS
Two quiet notifications a day, each carrying that moment's practice: a morning pick shaped by last night's sleep, recovery and HRV (6:00 AM by default), and a bedtime wind-down shaped by your day's strain and stress (9:30 PM by default). No sound unless you want it. Change the times or turn either one off.

THE LIBRARY BEHIND THE PICK
102 practices from 16 traditions: Zen, Tibetan, Yoga and Prāṇāyāma, Sufi, Taoist, Stoic, forest bathing, sport and recovery, modern breathwork and more, with goal tabs and search. Box breathing, 4·7·8, resonance breathing, Mettā, Centering Prayer and many more, each explained in plain English.

BREATHE BY FEEL
A slow glowing orb shows each inhale, hold and exhale. On Apple Watch, haptic taps mark every phase, so you can practice with your eyes closed and no sound.

SEE HOW YOU SETTLED
After a session with your Watch on, see your heart-rate curve, start and end heart rate, lowest and average, HRV, breathing rate and time in your calm zone. Each practice keeps its own trend, so you can see which ones settle you most.

MOVE A LITTLE FIRST
Eleven warm-up and stretch routines, 2 to 10 minutes each, with a figure for every step: Baduanjin, Tai Chi cloud hands, Radio Taisō, Makkō-hō, a slow Sun Salutation, Thai hermit stretches, Do-in self-massage and more.

YOUR JOURNEY
Every session is kept with its length and heart data, grouped by day. Streaks, minutes by kind, a 12-week calendar and milestones show how far you've come. Sessions are saved to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes, and tree hugs you log in Rootbound count toward your streak.

ON YOUR WRIST
The Apple Watch app runs the full library on its own: start a practice from your wrist, feel the taps, see your heart rate. Widgets and complications start your favorite practice in one tap, and Siri can start one for you.

FREE AND PRO
The starter set of 34 practices, including the 1-minute Calm SOS, a body scan and Tree Hugs, is free forever, along with Right now and the reminders. Still Pointz Pro unlocks every practice, every routine, the sauna and steam guide and the full Watch library. Choose monthly or yearly (with a free first week for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime unlock. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions at least 24 hours before the period ends.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your sessions stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch, and Health data never leaves your devices.

Still Pointz is for relaxation and general wellbeing. It is not a medical device, and its suggestions are not medical advice. Check with a doctor before breathwork or sauna use if you are pregnant or have a heart, lung or blood pressure condition. Still Pointz is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WHOOP.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in. Everything works offline.

What sets Still Pointz apart: instead of a library to browse, Today leads with one "Right now" practice picked from the person's own Apple Watch or WHOOP data in Apple Health (heart rate vs resting, HRV vs their own baseline, breathing rate, sleep, workouts and sauna/steam sessions), with every number shown under Why this?; a sauna and steam session timer; and two gentle daily notifications (6:00 AM and bedtime by default) that carry that moment's pick. The first-launch welcome leads with these three. Without Health data, Right now falls back to a time-of-day pick and says so.

Free tier: a starter set of 34 practices (including Calm SOS, body scan and Tree Hugs) and two movement routines. Pro (auto-renewable monthly com.troydunn.stillpoint.pro.monthly and yearly com.troydunn.stillpoint.pro.yearly, both with a 1-week free trial as Apple's introductory offer, plus the one-time lifetime unlock com.troydunn.stillpoint.pro) unlocks every practice, routine, the sauna/steam guide and the Watch library. To see the plans: tap any lock icon, or Journey › Pro, or Settings › Pro. Restore and Manage Subscription are on the same screen, with the renewal terms, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

HealthKit: reads heart rate, HRV, resting heart rate, breathing rate, sleep, steps, mindful minutes and workouts to show how a session went and to pick the Right now practice on Today (one practice for the moment; every number used is listed under Why this?); writes Mindful Minutes (and routines and sauna/steam sessions as workouts). Health data never leaves the device.

Notifications: two optional local notifications a day (morning and bedtime, Settings › Right now reminders) carry that moment's suggested practice.

Rootbound and Pulse Lab (our other apps) share small summaries with Still Pointz on the device through an App Group (recent tree hugs; today's recovery and readiness numbers); nothing is uploaded.

Apple Watch: the Watch app runs practices with haptic taps for each breath phase.
